summary: End-to-end testing of Lexora (Node/Express + React/Vite + PostgreSQL, proxied via FastAPI). All 16 backend pytest tests pass (auth, dashboard, projects list/detail, analytics, autopilot, trends list, library, trend analyze via gpt-5-mini, create project, generate outline, generate one chapter, generate marketing, chat SSE). All frontend pages load without errors: Login, Dashboard (real seeded stats: 4 complete, 180.5K words, 4 active), Projects (in-progress cards with covers/status/progress), Project Detail (Chapters/DNA/Marketing/Continuity/Market/Pacing/Business/Studio/Languages/Logs tabs render, cover shown), Library (5 completed books with covers incl. our TEST book from generation flow), Trend Intel (vertical demand board + Run Analysis form), Analytics, Autopilot, Settings, Marketing, Chat Studio (conversation list + composer). Unauthenticated access to protected routes displays the Login form (SPA-side gate) instead of the requested page.

minor.issue: Real generation takes 100-180s and hits the Kubernetes/Cloudflare edge 502 gateway timeout (~100s) even though the Node server completes and persists chapters. Frontend/user should treat this as fire-and-poll (poll GET /api/projects/:id for chapters) rather than expecting a synchronous 200. Test now polls; behavior confirmed correct on backend.
Same as above — real chapter generation may exceed the edge timeout; content is still saved. Consider streaming/SSE or an async job pattern to avoid 502s on slow generations.
Excludes status=='complete' projects by design (line 1266 routes.ts). Not a bug, but the frontend Projects page copy 'in-progress manuscripts' should stay in sync — currently correct.

ui_bugs.issue: When hitting /projects, /library etc. unauthenticated, the URL does NOT change to /login — the login form is rendered in-place. Minor UX issue; functionally auth is enforced.

issues: Cloudflare/ingress rate-limits the Vite HMR WebSocket (wss://.../?token=...) with HTTP 429, spamming the browser console. Non-blocking (dev-only) but noisy. Consider disabling HMR websocket in the preview build, or serving a production build.

action_items: Consider converting long-running generation endpoints (outline, chapter) to an async job pattern (POST returns 202 + job id, client polls) so the edge 502 disappears. Not strictly required — current polling works and data persists.

Optional: on the client, when an unauthenticated user hits a protected route, redirect the URL to /login (wouter setLocation) instead of only swapping components, so refreshes/back-nav behave predictably.
Optional: silence Vite HMR websocket in the preview environment to avoid console noise from 429 responses.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/server/routes.ts is 4600+ lines — should be split into per-resource routers (projects, chapters, trends, chat, autopilot, library, marketing) for maintainability.

/app/backend/server.py proxy has no upstream read timeout (good for SSE), but the outer ingress caps at ~100s, which is invisible to the Node app; consider explicit async job flow for AI-heavy endpoints.

insertProjectSchema validation on POST /api/projects returns 400 with err.message from Zod — good; make sure Pydantic-style structured errors are returned for the frontend to display field-level messages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for pages tested (all 9 pages render, all key tabs present, seeded data visible)

seed_data_creation: Created a new project via POST /api/projects titled 'TEST_Lexora Focus Rituals' (id ~9), then generated its outline (11 chapters), 1st chapter text, and marketing assets via real OpenAI calls. This project now appears in Library as 'Complete'. Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://eca3d45b-282d-4164-a0e2-536e87461cd8.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth is session-cookie (connect.sid, Secure, SameSite=None). Login via POST /api/auth/login {username, password}. /api/projects returns only in-progress; /api/library returns completed. Long AI calls (outline/chapter) exceed the ~100s edge timeout — POST them with a short timeout and poll GET /api/projects/:id (nested chapters[]) for results. FastAPI shim on :8001 spawns Node on :8500 and proxies all /api/*. Frontend Vite dev server on :3000 has HMR WS being rate-limited by the ingress (429) — harmless.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Outline/chapter test flakiness at first was purely due to ingress 100s edge timeout returning 502 while the Node backend continued executing and correctly persisted results (verified by re-fetching /api/projects/:id after the 502). Tests were adjusted to fire-and-poll to reflect the actual working behavior.
